result.summary: Found several visual issues: duplicate restaurant cards in the fastest section, truncated restaurant names, and a partially clipped category chip that goes beyond normal carousel peek behavior.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards side by side with the same image, delivery time, and price.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant list does not duplicate the same venue; show unique nearby restaurants only.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in 'Fastest near you' is truncated to 'Smash Bros Bu' and cut off at the card edge.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or use ellipsis with enough width so the full name (or a clear abbreviation) is readable.

issues.description: The category filter row ends with a barely visible partial chip after 'Healthy', which looks more like overflow clipping than an intentional peek of the next item.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent end padding to the horizontal scroller so the last fully visible chip isn't hard against a thin sliver of the next one, or ensure the peek shows a clearer portion of the next category.

issues.description: Delivery fee text under the truncated name ('€2.40 delivery') is harder to scan next to the cut-off title, compounding the cramped card layout.
issues.suggestion: Give card text a fixed min-height and consistent truncation rules so title and meta line remain balanced.
